title: Ultralocal charge-spectral matter densities cannot cancel the lifted electric-current leakage

modified_energy_boundary.initial_data: On normalized T3 choose Qv=qv with q nonzero, phi(x)=r exp(i k dot x)v, pi=D_t phi=0, A=0 and a constant divergence-free electric field E0 with E0 dot k nonzero
modified_energy_boundary.constraint_check: The charge density rho=e Im<Q phi,pi> vanishes and div E0=0, so the Gauss constraint holds at the testing time
modified_energy_boundary.stationary_scalar_densities: Every ultralocal charge-spectral scalar S_ab=Re<Q^a phi,Q^b phi>=q^(a+b)r^2 is spatially constant and has zero time derivative because pi=0; the radial coefficient partial_t||phi||^2 also vanishes
modified_energy_boundary.live_current: For every lifted tier n, j_n=e Im<Q^(n+1)phi,D Q^n phi> equals e q^(2n+1) k r^2 up to the fixed inner-product sign convention, hence integral E0 dot j_n is nonzero
modified_energy_boundary.no_go_class: The time derivative of any differentiable correction integral F({S_ab}) dx built only from finitely many ultralocal charge-spectral matter densities is zero on these data and therefore cannot cancel K1413's nonzero electric-current work for all constrained solutions
modified_energy_boundary.required_escape: A successful correction must leave this class by depending on the gauge or Maxwell fields, covariant/spatial derivatives, a nonlocal spacetime normal form, or a higher/summable hierarchy
modified_energy_boundary.ceiling: This excludes only ultralocal matter-density corrections. It is not a no-go for gauge-field-dependent, derivative, bilinear spacetime, secondary-null, nonlocal or higher-tier modified energies
